cases.sentence: На ___ обойдите вокруг города семь раз со священниками, трубящими в рога.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.

cases.sentence: На ___ они поднялись на заре и обошли вокруг города семь раз таким же образом.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. They did this six days.

cases.sentence: И на ___, когда священники протрубили в рога, Иисус велел народу:
cases.explain: «седьмой раз» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times. On this day only they marched around the city seven times.

cases.sentence: Все серебро, золото и изделия из бронзы и железа — это ___, они поступят в Его сокровищницу.
cases.explain: «Господня святыня» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But as for you, only keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction, lest when you have devoted it, you take of the devoted thing; so you would make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it.

cases.sentence: Когда рога протрубили, народ закричал, и при ___, когда народ издал громкий крик, стена рухнула до самого основания.
cases.explain: «трубном звуке» — after the preposition «при», for location or topic.
cases.translation: But all the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to Yahweh. They shall come into Yahweh’s treasury.”

cases.sentence: Когда рога протрубили, народ закричал, и при трубном звуке, когда народ издал громкий крик, стена рухнула до ___.
cases.explain: «самого основания» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But all the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to Yahweh. They shall come into Yahweh’s treasury.”

cases.sentence: Они посвятили город Господу и истребили в нем мечом всякое ___ — мужчин и женщин, молодых и стариков, волов, овец и ослов.
cases.explain: «живое существо» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city.

cases.sentence: Они вывели всю ее семью и оставили их за пределами ___.
cases.explain: «израильского лагеря» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house, and bring the woman and all that she has out from there, as you swore to her.”
